title: Canceling stamps: Threshold file
summary: Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k.
descriptionMd:
Matching cancellation stamps erase each other when they meet at the top of the paper pile. Pia marks a threshold on the filing cabinet's inspection card. Only qualifying readings count toward today's clearance stamp.

Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top.

Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k.

Implement cancelingStampsThresholdFile(readings, k). Use k exactly where specified above.
unitIntro: Stack cancellation. Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with stack cancellation. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [7,-3,7,0,12]. Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k. This gives 3.
The derived sequence is [-2,4]. Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k. This gives 1.
The derived sequence is []. Return how many values in the derived sequence are at least k. This gives 0.

overview: Edge-case trap: Stack cancellation. Build the sequence once, then report exactly what the inspection card requests.
